properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA family algorithms are referenced as dependencies in circomlib package-lock.json, but these are not actual cryptographic operations performed by the application code itself - they are just declared dependencies.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 curve used in ECDSA signatures for zk-SNARKs, specifically referenced in the Spartan-ECDSA project for circuit verification. This is a classical (non-post-quantum) curve vulnerable to Shor's algorithm.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Multiple ECDSA signature references in zkbugs configuration files from various circom projects (Arianee, Aptos, Iden3, etc.). These represent actual usage of classical ECDSA signatures in zero-knowledge circuits, which are vulnerable to quantum attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project uses the elliptic library (version 6.5.4) which provides ECDH functionality. While this is only a dependency reference and not actual code usage, it's part of the cryptographic surface of the project and should be included in the inventory as an algorithm that could be used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project references BLAKE2/BLAKE3 hashing algorithms through dependencies. These are hash functions that could be used for cryptographic purposes in the circuits or tests within this library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project has references to SHA-3 hashing algorithms through various dependencies and configuration files. These are cryptographic hash functions that could be used in circuits or tests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project has references to PBKDF2 key derivation function through various dependencies. This is a cryptographic algorithm that could be used for password-based key derivation in circuits or tests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project has references to scrypt key derivation function through various dependencies. This is a cryptographic algorithm that could be used for password-based key derivation in circuits or tests.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project has references to SHA-256 hashing algorithm through dependencies and actual test code. This is a cryptographic hash function that is used in the project's test suite for verifying SHA-256 functionality.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Usage of crypto.randomBytes(32) in generateInput.js for generating private keys and messages. This is a CSPRNG usage but the actual cryptographic primitives used are not specified here - they depend on the underlying Node.js crypto implementation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project depends on scrypt-js, which is a JavaScript implementation of the scrypt key derivation function. This is part of the cryptographic libraries used in the project.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The circomlib project depends on elliptic, which is a JavaScript implementation of elliptic curve cryptography including ECDH functionality. This is part of the cryptographic libraries used in the project.
